slide_title: Where to Get Filters for Recognition

bullets: Similarly, if images are k-D, parameters should also be k-D
For K=3 (RGB), use K-D filter (third dim >> K=3)
For K=9 (Satellite images) use 9-D filter (3rd dim = 9)
labels: [thin red horizontal rule across very top edge of slide]
[solid black bar along very bottom edge of slide]
equations: 3rd dim = 9 (the 'rd' in '3rd' is rendered as a superscript)

visual_elements.description: White rectangular text panel with a medium-weight blue border. Contains four left-aligned lines: (1) 'Similarly, if images are k-D, parameters should also be k-D' where 'Similarly,', 'if images are k-D' (underlined), ',' and 'parameters' (underlined) are blue and 'should also be k-D' is red; (2) 'For K=3 (RGB), use K-D filter (third dim >> K=3)' where 'For K=3 (RGB),' and '(third dim >> K=3)' are blue and 'use K-D filter' is red; (3) 'For K=9 (Satellite images) use 9-D filter (3rd dim = 9)' where 'For K=9 (Satellite images)' and '(3rd dim = 9)' are blue (superscript 'rd') and 'use 9-D filter' is red; (4) '...etc' in blue.

Left sub-diagram 'Grayscale': a flat 2D image depicted as a brown parallelogram plane drawn in perspective (dark tan/brown fill, slightly darker edge), with a small light-blue square sitting on its upper-right area representing the filter; handwritten-style black label 'Grayscale' above the plane.

Center sub-diagram 'RGB': a 3D slab/box drawn in perspective (light tan front face, lighter tan top, darker tan side edges) representing a 3-dimensional image volume; a 3D light-blue rectangular filter with darker blue edges stands on the slab's front face; handwritten black label 'RGB' above; small black text '3 dims' to the left with a short black arrow pointing right at the slab's depth (third) dimension.

Right sub-diagram 'Multiple channels': same style tan 3D slab in perspective representing a k-channel image volume; a 3D light-blue cube filter with darker blue edges sits on its front face; handwritten black label 'Multiple channels' above; small black text 'k dims' to the left with a short black arrow pointing right at the slab's depth dimension.

Red callout: the word 'Filters' in red handwritten-style text sits below-right of the grayscale plane; thin red lines radiate from it — a short arrow up-left to the blue square on the grayscale plane, a long thin line right to the blue filter on the RGB slab, and a longer thin line to the blue cube on the Multiple-channels slab — indicating the blue patches are the filters.
visual_elements.position: lower-left of diagram panel, lines crossing the full panel width

imagery: No photographs. Three flat vector-style 3D illustrations drawn with solid fills and darker outlines: (1) a brown parallelogram plane (grayscale image) with a small blue square filter, left side; (2) a tan 3D slab (RGB volume) with a blue rectangular filter, center; (3) a tan 3D slab (multi-channel volume) with a blue cube filter, right side. Labels are in a casual handwritten/marker-style font.
typography_notes: Title: large bold serif (Times New Roman Bold-like), title case, red, centered. Body text: bold serif, ~20pt equivalent, two-color scheme (blue primary, red for key phrases 'should also be k-D', 'use K-D filter', 'use 9-D filter'), with underlines on 'if images are k-D' and 'parameters', and a superscript 'rd' in '3rd'. Diagram labels ('Grayscale', 'RGB', 'Multiple channels', '3 dims', 'k dims', 'Filters') use a casual handwritten/marker-style sans font (Comic Sans-like), black except 'Filters' which is red. No numbered or bulleted markers — lines are plain paragraphs.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built; all four text lines and all three diagrams are visible; nothing looks mid-build.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray #DEDEDE. Add a thin red (#CC0000) horizontal line/rectangle across the very top edge (full width, ~2px). Add a solid black rectangle bar across the very bottom edge (full width, ~4% of slide height). 2. Add a centered text box near the top (~y 12-22%) with the text 'Where to Get Filters for Recognition' in bold serif (Times New Roman Bold), ~40pt, color #CC0000. 3. Insert a white rectangle with a ~2pt blue (#0000CC) border from ~8% to ~92% width and ~26% to ~49% height. Inside, left-aligned bold serif ~20pt lines: Line 1: 'Similarly, ' (blue #0000CC) + 'if images are k-D' (blue, underlined) + ', ' (blue) + 'parameters' (blue, underlined) + ' should also be k-D' (red #CC0000). Line 2: 'For K=3 (RGB), ' (blue) + 'use K-D filter' (red) + ' (third dim >> K=3)' (blue). Line 3: 'For K=9 (Satellite images) ' (blue) + 'use 9-D filter' (red) + ' (3' (blue) + 'rd' (blue, superscript) + ' dim = 9)' (blue). Line 4: '...etc' (blue). 4. Insert a white rectangle with a thin (~1.5pt) red (#CC0000) border from ~9% to ~90% width and ~56% to ~93% height as the diagram panel. 5. Left third: draw a brown (#9A6A10) parallelogram (flat plane in perspective, darker outline); place a small light-blue (#29ABE2) square on its upper-right area; add handwritten-font (e.g., Comic Sans MS) black label 'Grayscale' above it. 6. Center: draw a 3D slab using freeform shapes — front face #E8C89A, top face #F2DCB4, side edges #C89B62; add a 3D light-blue (#29ABE2, edges #1B7FA8) rectangular filter on the front face; add handwritten black label 'RGB' above; add small black text '3 dims' left of the slab with a short black arrow pointing to the slab's depth edge. 7. Right third: duplicate the tan slab; add a 3D light-blue cube filter (#29ABE2, edges #1B7FA8) on its front face; add handwritten black label 'Multiple channels' above; add small black text 'k dims' with a short black arrow pointing to the depth edge. 8. Add red (#FF0000) handwritten-font text 'Filters' below-right of the grayscale plane; draw thin red connector lines: one short arrow from 'Filters' to the blue square on the grayscale plane, one long line to the blue filter on the RGB slab, and one long line to the blue cube on the Multiple-channels slab.
